semiconductor_relevance: High — Linggas specializes in ultra-high purity specialty gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing and related industries.
summary: Linggas (Tianjin), Limited. develops and manufactures ultra-high purity specialty gases for the semiconductor, photovoltaic, LED, and LCD industries. The company operates a specialty gas plant in Tianjin and is certified with ISO9001, ISO14000, and OHSAS18001:1999 standards, ensuring consistent product quality and reliable service.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity specialty gases for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: Linggas operates a specialty gas plant in Tianjin, focusing on the semiconductor and related industries.
